title: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String
statement: Return the index of the first occurrence of needle in haystack, or -1 when it does not occur.
hints: The straightforward approach tries every starting position and compares forward.
That is O(n*m), which is fine at these limits.
If you want to go further, look up Knuth-Morris-Pratt, which precomputes how far to jump on a mismatch to reach O(n + m).
complexity: O(n*m) time naively, O(n+m) with KMP
